configurationNote: Playbook Studio changes configuration only. Publishing a version is not a business approval and grants no approval rights; existing transformations keep their pinned version until a deliberate, approved migration.
readOnly: You can view this configuration. Changing it needs the methodology administrator's permissions.

state.preview: Draft — in preview and test (not published)

versions.title: Configuration versions
versions.empty: No configuration version matches these filters.

create.title: New draft version
create.body: The draft starts as a copy of a published version. Only one draft can be open per configuration.
create.baseHint: Choose the published version to start from.

version.draftNote: This is a draft. Nothing here is used by any transformation until it is published, and existing transformations keep their pinned version even then.
version.immutable: This version is published and cannot be changed. To change it, create a new draft; to restore it, roll back.

pipeline.title: Draft, preview and test, review, publish
pipeline.intro: Each check runs on the current content. A check that ran on earlier content is Stale and must run again before publishing.
pipeline.reviewRequired: A review is required for this configuration before it can be published.
pipeline.reviewNotRequired: No review is configured for this configuration; it can be published after its checks.

publish.hint: Publishing checks the review, the checks and the invariants again on the server; a refusal is shown above.

rollback.title: Roll back to version {{n}}
rollback.body: Rollback creates a new draft whose content equals this version; it goes through the same checks, review and publish. Records created under later versions stay retrievable, and the audit trail records the rollback.

elements.title: Elements
elements.intro: Labels, help text and routing of the methodology elements. Stable keys never change; seeded source elements cannot be deleted.
elements.otherScreen: This configuration kind is edited on its own screen.
elements.stableKeyHint: Letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore; it can never change later.
elements.label: Label
elements.addBody: A new element exists only in this draft until it is published.
elements.editBody: Changes apply to this draft only. An empty text keeps the shipped text.
elements.roleHint: A role code such as SP, TO or FIN. The methodology administrator can never be an approver.
elements.flagHint: Leave it on “Choose…” to keep the shipped setting.

mode.sequential: Sequential: one step after another, in the order below
mode.any: Any one of the roles (single-step approval)

route.modeHint: Sequential and parallel routes need 2 to 6 business roles in the ordered list. Leave it on “Choose…” for a single approver role.
route.rolesHint: Role codes such as SP, BO or FIN, in the order the steps run. Use either this list or the single approver role, not both.

elements.changeUnknown: The comparison with the base version could not be loaded.

diff.title: Differences from the base version
diff.intro: Side by side: the base version's value and this version's value.
diff.caption: Changed elements
diff.empty: No differences from the base version.
diff.noBase: This version has no base version to compare with.
diff.changedLegend: Changed: the value differs from the base version.

affected.title: Affected records
affected.intro: Records of transformations that could move to this version by a migration. Nothing changes for them until then.

review.heading: Review of {{title}}
review.submitBody: The reviewers of the configured role receive a review task. The draft cannot be edited while the review is open.
review.pending: A review request is waiting for a decision.
review.decideBody: Approve the configuration change, or request changes with a note. This is a configuration review, not a business approval.
review.ownRequest: You requested this review, so you cannot decide it.

defaults.title: T06 scoring defaults
defaults.summary: The default weights and 1–5 rubric of the Prioritization Scorecard that new transformations start from.
defaults.openVersion: Open this version in the Studio
defaults.publishedNote: This version is published and cannot be changed. Create a draft to change the defaults.
defaults.createDraft: Create a draft from this version
defaults.savedDraft: Draft saved. It is not published: new transformations still start from the published defaults.
defaults.weightsIntro: Leave a weight empty to leave the criterion out. A draft can be saved with any total; publishing requires exactly 100.00 %.
defaults.weightHint: A decimal percentage, at most two decimals.
defaults.totalNot100: Does not total 100 % — publishing will be refused
defaults.publishHint: Publish from the version page, after its checks and review.

policies.title: Review policies
policies.summary: Whether each configuration kind needs a review before publishing, and which role reviews it.
policies.readOnly: Only the Transformation Office can change review policies.

proposals.title: Revision proposals
proposals.summary: Each proposed methodology or formula revision, with its validation, its impact and the review tasks it created.

coverage.readOnly: You can view the report. Running the check needs the methodology administrator's permissions.
coverage.openVersion: Open this version in the Studio
coverage.intro: A version whose source-coverage check fails cannot be published.
coverage.runDraftOnly: The check runs on a draft version: choose an open draft to run it.

migration.planBody: The migration plan lists default mappings, new required fields, invalidated calculations and the gate re-approvals the move needs. Nothing moves until the plan is approved and executed.
migration.targetHint: A newer published version of the same configuration.
migration.noTarget: No newer published version of this configuration exists.
migration.approvalNote: Approving a methodology migration is a business decision inside the product, made by its approver (the Executive Sponsor by default). It is not an engineering delivery gate.
migration.readOnly: You can view migrations. Planning, approving or executing one needs the matching permission.
migration.emptyBody: Publishing a new version does not move this transformation; plan a migration to move it.
migration.heading: Migration of the {{kind}} configuration
migration.decisionNote: You are deciding this migration as its business approver. Your rationale is recorded with the decision.
migration.inputsIntro: Leave a value empty to leave the field empty until the record's next edit. Refresh the plan to apply the values.
migration.planIntro: Historical records, submissions, snapshots and decisions stay exactly as they are; the migration only moves the pin.

reapproval.title: Gate re-approvals
reapproval.intro: A gate approved before a migration may need business re-approval. The earlier decision stays in history; the next gate cannot be submitted until the re-approval.

pins.title: Configuration pins
pins.intro: The configuration version this transformation uses for each kind. Only an executed migration moves a pin.
pins.historyEmpty: This transformation has never been migrated.
